A1.justification: Both PDFs contain the same OminiControl paper and complete supplementary material across 18 readable pages. Text and rendered-page comparisons establish that the scientific content is identical; the visible difference is the first-page arXiv version/date stamp.

before.justification: v5 reports original generation experiments, quantitative comparisons and ablations in Section 4, plus supplementary evaluations and a user study with 375 valid responses in Appendix B.

after.justification: v6 retains these original experiments, ablations, supplementary results and user study, including Tables 2, 3 and S1.

M1.justification: Section 3 retains the same VAE reuse, LoRA adaptation, unified token processing, task-dependent positioning and attention-bias mechanism. No algorithmic component or procedure changes.

E1.justification: Both retain text-to-image-2M and Subjects200K training data, COCO 2017 and DreamBooth evaluation, and identical spatially aligned and subject-driven task coverage, including the supplementary scenarios.

E2.justification: ControlNet, T2I-Adapter, ControlNet Pro and FLUX Tools retain the same participation in Table 2. IP-Adapter variants and SSR-Encoder remain unchanged in Table S1, as do the qualitative comparisons, including Figure S6.

E3.justification: Section 4.1 retains the same base models, training budgets, metrics and preprocessing, including 5,000 COCO images resized to 512 by 512 and 750 DreamBooth text-condition pairs. Appendix evaluation and user-study procedures are also identical.

E4.justification: The integration and positioning studies, conditioning-strength tests, LoRA rank and component ablations, and training-data comparison are unchanged in Figures 3–5, 9–10 and S4 and Table 3. No supplementary analysis is added or removed.

E5.justification: Both report a fixed seed of 42 for spatial evaluation and average and best scores over five random seeds for subject-driven generation. The repeated-evaluation information and uncertainty-reporting practices are unchanged.

E6.justification: All numerical entries and qualitative result figures are identical. For example, OminiControl's Canny F1 remains 0.50 in Table 2, and its average modification accuracy remains 75.8% in Table S1.

T1.justification: Equations (1)–(6), including the attention formulation, positional assignment and conditioning-bias matrix, are unchanged. Neither version contains additional theorems or proofs.

C1.justification: The abstract, contribution list and conclusion are identical, retaining the same claims about universal image control, approximately 0.1% additional parameters, the technical mechanisms and Subjects200K.

C2.justification: Both retain the same interpretations of positional alignment, conditioning depth and normalization/attention components. Section 5 preserves the limitation that the additional tokens may reduce inference efficiency.

D1.justification: The implementation settings, optimizer, hardware and training details in Section 4.1 and dataset synthesis/filtering instructions in Appendix A are identical. Embedded code and data link targets are unchanged.

R1.justification: Sections 2 and 3.2.4 and all 63 bibliography entries are identical. No cited work or positioning relative to prior and concurrent methods changes.

P1.justification: The first-page arXiv stamp changes from v5, dated 11 March 2025, to v6, dated 7 July 2025. The title, authors, prose, terminology, section order and appendix structure are otherwise identical.

P2.justification: Figures 1–10 and S1–S8, Tables 1–3 and S1, captions, formatting and placement are identical. Pages 2–18 render identically; page 1 differs only in the marginal version/date text, without a layout revision.

improvement.justification: v6 preserves the same scientific text, evidence, mathematical content, limitations and appendices. The arXiv stamp and bibliographic PDF metadata updates do not meaningfully improve or diminish the paper's clarity, scientific support or reproducibility.
